revisions.content: Never truncate the active log file while the process holds it — the space is not reclaimed until restart. Rotate first, then delete the rotated files, then extend the volume.
revisions.reason: truncating an open file did not free space and caused a second page

runbook.content: Truncate rotated logs older than 3 days, then extend the LVM volume by 20GB and restart the ingest workers.

title: Disk usage at 98% on the log volume
